title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
taper: Thanks to Bob Murphy for the Seed Disks

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a sweet, hidden show that ranks alongside the legendary 2/15/73.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about this recording as a well‑kept secret, noting that even though the second set is out of order it remains “so sweet” and comparable to one of the Dead’s classic performances. The soundboard source delivers clear, vivid audio that lets the music shine without any reported flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review praises both the performance and the soundboard quality, indicating a top‑tier show and excellent recording, but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No technical complaints; reviewer implies high clarity and fidelity typical of a good soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set out of order but still flows beautifully, described as “sweet” and comparable to the famed 2/15/73 show.
